items.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997
items.q: He was on most the tracks, and Billy Hart was on the rest of it.

ctx.x: Right. Well actually, Michael Moore had written several of those tunes that were on “Ambiance” and then I had written “Ambiance” and there was a couple of other things. But we had this very freestyle drummer too, Jimmy Madison. He was on most the tracks, and Billy Hart was on the rest of it. And boy if I could just set up that same thing again I probably would get into that same bag. You’re making me think I should do some more. I mean I can and I do, like every time on “Piano Jazz” if the guest wants to do it,…
